house.description: Veterans service office grant program modified, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Veterans and Military Affairs Division

additions: Up to $60,000 of this amount may be used to train technical assistance coordinators and for technical assistance coordinators to travel to consult with Minnesota counties on specific areas of expertise upon request. The Minnesota Association of County Veterans Service Officers executive board must select technical assistance coordinators, who are either county veterans service officers or assistant county veterans service officers, to serve for a minimum of one year.
APPROPRIATION; VETERANS SERVICE OFFICE GRANT PROGRAM.

$60,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $60,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to the Minnesota Association of County Veterans Service Officers under Minnesota Statutes, section 197.608, subdivision 6, paragraph (c). Of this amount, $20,000 is for a women veterans technical assistance coordinator, $20,000 is for a veteran suicide prevention technical assistance coordinator, and $20,000 is for a justice-involved veteran technical assistance coordinator. Any unencumbered balance in fiscal year 2026 does not cancel and is available in fiscal year 2027.
